evidence.field: modern pinyin; code point; cited readings
evidence.text: The entry identifies 𢇅 as U+221C5 and gives its modern pinyin as guān. It reports historical fanqie 古還切 and 姑還切 in the cited lexicographic material, while noting a Kangxi redirection to the distinct graph 𢇇. The modern reading is not itself evidence of an ancient sound relationship.
evidence.title: 𢇅 guān - 汉典

evidence.text: The official record for 關 U+95DC gives kMandarin guān. This is current reading metadata, not evidence for an ancient sound relationship.
evidence.title: Unihan data for U+95DC

evidence.text: The entry quotes 說文 as analyzing 關 as 从門、𢇅聲 and gives 關’s fanqie 古還切. It reports competing interpretations of bronze forms and links to examples labelled bronze and seal script. The opened linked seal image URL is a database-rendered glyph, but no reuse permission for that image was verified.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫

evidence.text: The local Unihan host row gives 關 kMandarin guān; the entry for the distinct U+221C7 𢇇 gives guān, not the dossier component U+221C5 𢇅. No exact local U+221C5 reading row was found. The Baxter–Sagart rows give host 關 Middle Chinese kwaen and Old Chinese *[k]ˤro[n] (with a separate variant entry for the linchpin expression); no component row for 𢇅 was found. These local readings cannot be treated as a same-system historical pair.
evidence.title: Unihan data for U+95DC

search_audit.query: 𢇅 guān 古還切 關 古文字 phonetic character; 關 金文 字形 關 bronze inscription character image Commons
search_audit.outcome: Search found and inspected the ZDIC and CUHK entries. The component entry reports modern pinyin guān; CUHK reports 關’s fanqie 古還切 and its Shuowen analysis. The searched Commons results did not identify a reusable 關 glyph file.

search_audit.query: Search for live official Unihan reading of 關 and a direct CUHK historical glyph image link
search_audit.outcome: The official U+95DC page opened and records kMandarin guān; U+221C5 remained inaccessible. CUHK’s direct bronze page returned no readable contents, and its direct seal image URL was exposed by the entry but the page did not establish reuse rights.

search_audit.query: site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File 關-bronze.svg Chinese character 關 bronze; Wikimedia Commons 關 seal script image Chinese character 關; 𢇅-bronze.svg Commons character
search_audit.outcome: Inspected returned Commons file results. They depict other characters, not 關, so none was selected.

gaps: The modern Mandarin comparison is supported by separate sources: ZDIC gives 𢇅 guān and official Unihan gives 關 guān. The exact official Unihan record for 𢇅 U+221C5 remained inaccessible, and the local Unihan file has no exact U+221C5 row; the U+221C7 𢇇 reading must not be substituted.

No same-system historical reconstruction pair for 𢇅 and 關 was verified. Local Baxter–Sagart data covers 關 only. The matching traditional fanqie reports support a lexicographic reading comparison but do not independently prove the phonetic relationship.

No historical glyph is proposed. CUHK displays and labels candidate forms and exposes direct image links, but the opened linked pages did not provide readable image content or establish reuse rights. Commons searches returned files for other characters, not 關. The Xiaoxuetang entry-specific glyph was not verified.

limitations.text: No usable image candidate with verified identity and reuse provenance was established. CUHK’s 關 page exposes a seal-script glyph URL, but the linked image page did not establish reuse rights; its bronze link returned no readable contents. The searched Commons files were for other characters. No candidate image is therefore proposed.
